snippet.title: Huglings - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Huglings is a cozy adventure for 1-4 players where you can help the huglings restore their village, which was damaged by the goblins. Create peace as you farm, craft, and decorate your dream home. No pressure, just a peaceful world to explore and a heartwarming journey of friendship and helpfulness!

✨Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4305790/Huglings/

🌺 Discord: https://discord.gg/NHhGMZemuP
